shard1.selection: last block at or before requested cutoff

valuation.note: Used for historical reporting only; public eligibility is ONE-denominated.

withheld_fields: exchange wallet inventories, destinations, memos, and address outcomes

wone_overlay.holder_source: cutoff-pinned archival-node event replay reconciled to totalSupply and native reserve
wone_overlay.qualified_holder_treatment: wallet airdrop with matching reserve source classified as redistributed
wone_overlay.remainder_treatment: not issued; retained in the 2050 premint reserve

selected_policy.threshold_timing: evaluate snapshot qualification before deductions or routing
selected_policy.initial_stage: positive eligible wallets with indexed activity in the six calendar months before cutoff
selected_policy.code_bearing_accounts: preliminary review; verified validator-wrapper accounts remain key-controlled wallets
selected_policy.reviewed_contracts: multisig, LayerZero collateral, and 1wallet allocations are next stage; SmartVault and other reviewed genuine-contract allocations are not issued
selected_policy.stage_and_treatment: migration stage, issuance treatment, account classification, and destination readiness are separate fields

exchange_delivery_overlay.gate: ordinary inclusive threshold and account classification; no aggregate reroute
exchange_delivery_overlay.non_gate: remove qualifying submitted wallets from implicit automatic delivery and route positive current claims to a confirmed aggregate exchange destination
exchange_delivery_overlay.submitted_balance_role: reconciliation evidence only; never a replacement for cutoff chain accounting

excluded_uncertainty.reason: Destination spent status on retired shards 2 and 3 is not provable from the active shard databases; excluded to avoid double counting.

methods: exchange normalization, overlap, signature, and route closure checks
